title: A Name Came Up
description: A name came up from below. Hessa wants it read where it was cut, not guessed at in the common room.

fetch.title: Read the name
fetch.objective: Go further down and find the inscription.
fetch.journal: Hessa wants a name that came up from below read where it was cut.

returned.title: Calder
returned.journal: The wall said Calder, twice. Hessa already knew.
